text: Going to Europe this fall?
Don't check a bag for Paris,
Milan and London.
I pack one weekender and it
goes in the overhead bin.
This is the Eleanor Weekender from Velantra.
Paris is where you pack less,
pieces that work together,
so three days of clothes fit
in here, and the flap folds
all the way back so I
can see everything.
Milan is where it gets polished and intentional.
Full grain leather over woven canvas,
real brass hardware, no logo anywhere,
and it keeps its shape packed
full or barely at all.
London is where you walk all
day and it's four seasons in
one day, so the knitwear and
the coat come too,
and it still keeps its shape.
I've dragged mine through three airports
and it still looks new.
It comes in four colors,
and the black one is a
pre-order that ships mid September.
They're running a sale on it
right now and the colors go
fast, so grab it before the trip.
So tell me, Paris,
Milan or London.
Which one are you packing for?
I left the link below.
